version: 0.4.0
kind: menu-binding
schema_type: object

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.menu-binding
  name: menu-binding.schema
  description: Canonical schema defining bindings between menu-items and actions or panes.

spec:
  target_kind: menu-binding
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: menuItem
    path: menuItem
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: action
    path: action
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: pane
    path: pane
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: parameters
    path: parameters
    type: object
    required: false

object:
  menuItem: ""
  action: ""
  pane: ""
  parameters: {}
